steps.conclusion: Several items do not genuinely require the case. Item 1 supplies the imminent health risk that justifies immediate enforcement; item 2 can be rejected from its general claim about the burden of proof; and item 3 can be rejected simply because revocation does not have retroactive effects. Make the case supply the decisive facts instead of repeating them in the statements.
